name.en-US: The History of Richard Raynal, Solitary
name.pt-BR: A História de Richard Raynal, Eremita

description.en-US: Benson's medieval tale of 1906, presented as a recovered manuscript of Sir John, a priest of Edward IV's time: the life of the young hermit Richard Raynal, his visions, his journey to London and his death.
description.pt-BR: A narrativa medieval de Benson (1906), apresentada como manuscrito recuperado de Sir John, sacerdote do tempo de Eduardo IV: a vida do jovem eremita Richard Raynal, suas visões, sua viagem a Londres e sua morte.

sources.edition: The History of Richard Raynal, Solitary (London: Isbister, 1906), Project Gutenberg #15808, proofread.
sources.description: Gutenberg licence and transcriber notes are dropped. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1906, so the text is public domain.
